basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and policy debater, I've been exploring the depths of Reddit for nearly a decade. Hailing from Seattle, I work as a software engineer by day and debate enthusiast by night. My interests range from the strategic battles of Beyblade to the whimsical world of Harry Potter. I'm single and often online during late evenings, when I unwind with a good game or a heated policy discussion. I dislike superficial content and always seek depth in conversation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and a penchant for self-learning, I have honed my skills in software development and digital content creation. My knowledge extends to game mechanics and debate tactics, thanks to years of passionate involvement in both.
